avis.texte: I have sunspots due to years of living on the beach in Florida. I've tried a few retinol creams in the past. I could truly see a difference within a month of using Exuviance Age Reverse. My brown spots diminished significantly and my skin looked smoother and less red.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. Im not sure if I like it or not. It was really light structure, a little heavy actually. I received a small size which is easy for me to carry on my trip or traveling. Will consider later about this.

avis.titre: Not strong enough for mature skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wanted to love this Exuviance Advanced Retinol Serum.. I received it free for a product review. Even tho it was free to me, I got find the price on Ulta's website to factor that in on my review. Price point was great, however its result not so much. I did not experience any redness or irritation. I'm 43 and have used a ton of Retinol products over the last 15 years, chasing that fountain of youth.. some worked great, but you paid a hefty price for that greatness. I guess it's true to get what you pay for. For my maturing skin, I need a more advanced product. Retinol is listed 14th down in the ingredients, and it doesn't specify the %. I would recommend this product for someone 10-15 years younger, just starting out their beauty routine to maintain what they have. However I would recommend a stronger product for corrective purposes. I gave 3 stars for smell, it is pleasant, and absorption, and price point, not for the results I experienced, unfortunately.

I am so frustrated because I spent quite a good amount of time researching and trying to find a good retinol serum. I went to my Ulta and spoke with a certain male who sounded very authoritative and like he knew what he was talking about. It probably was not his fault, but I purchased this very expensive serum and it was halfway full. I tried to return it after four days and they would not accept it even though it was in its full case I'm super super upset. It was very expensive. Do not buy

I received this product for my honest review. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked the gentleness of this product. I did see a reduction of lose skin. avis.titre: Gentle yet effective retinol serum that improves texture, gl

My skin feels softer, looks brighter, and more refined since using it. I noticed improved texture and a healthier overall glow. This feels like a high-quality, effective skincare product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was genuinely surprised at how quickly this stuff started working. I saw results within a week. My texture evened out and my dark spots were diminished.

The packaging is another big plus: it's very convenient to use, hygienic, and compact, making it easy to take while traveling. Overall, this is a great retinol serum that delivers results without sacrificing comfort. I'm very happy with it and will definitely be repurchasing.

For someone interested in retinol and ready to commit to proper use (night-only, sunscreen, gradual ramp-up), this serum could be a solid addition — more effective and "real" than many mild over-the-counter serums, but gentler than prescription retinoids.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Exuviance Advanced Renewal Retinol Serum and I'm honestly blown away.
